## P3DR1 final read-only re-review

**Sources:** `research/cursor-execution/P3D-composer-review-result.json`, `docs/cursor-packets/P3DR1-detail-integrity.md`, `research/cursor-execution/P3DR1-worker-report.md`, and current implementation/tests (`detail-canonical-contract.ts`, `access.ts`, `detail-project.ts`, `project-content.ts`, `PronunciationControl.tsx`, `media-copy.ts`, `p3d-details.test.ts`, `p3d-details-ui.test.ts`, `DetailViews.tsx`, `learner-details.json`, `p3c-search.test.ts` boundaries, smoke detail checks).

P3D listed **three** P2 lines; P3DR1 treats **content integrity** (array↔`byId` + golden German) and **audio affordance** as the two remediation tracks. Below maps all three original P3D P2 risks.

---

### Prior P2 closure

| Original P3D P2 | Status | Evidence |
|-----------------|--------|----------|
| **`representatives` ↔ `representativesById` not structurally bound** | **Closed** | `assertLearnerDetailProjection` enforces exact `representativesById` key set vs `DETAIL_REPRESENTATIVE_IDS`, then `stableStringifyDetailValue(record) === stableStringifyDetailValue(byId)` before serving (`access.ts` ~602–626). Adversarial **`byId-only`** case mutates only `verb:sein` in `representativesById` and expects throw with no `binY` in the message (`p3d-details.test.ts` ~248–280). |
| **Runtime assert did not pin learner-visible German** | **Closed** | `detail-canonical-contract.ts` centralizes pins; `assertDetailRecord` compares vocab (`displayText`, lemma/article/gender/singular/meaning, empty plurals + gap message, full `personForm`), seven ordered `(person, form)` for `verb:sein`, and Q&A question + three answer realizations (`access.ts` ~477–570). Adversarial **vocabulary / verb / qa** cases (array + `byId` synced) throw; errors omit invented strings (`p3d-details.test.ts` ~173–282). |
| **Enabled “Play” without playback** | **Closed** | `resolveAudioControl` always returns `canPlay: false` for `pending-review`, `approved`, and `missing`; `PronunciationControl` always renders a **disabled** button (`disabled`, `aria-disabled="true"`, `tabIndex={-1}`), “Pronunciation unavailable”, plus status copy — no `canPlay` branch and no `<audio>` / Play label (`PronunciationControl.tsx`). UI test: synthetic `approved` + `assetId` → `canPlay` false, exact `approved; activation pending`, no “Play pronunciation” / `<audio>` (`p3d-details-ui.test.ts` ~170–209). |

**Packet extras (verified):**

- **Generation assert before write:** `project-content.ts` calls `assertLearnerDetailProjection(details)` immediately before `writeFileSync` (~55–58).
- **Exact representative set:** `representativeCount === 3`, array length 3, sorted `byId` keys match `DETAIL_REPRESENTATIVE_IDS` (~591–608).
- **Pending-review copy exact:** `PRONUNCIATION_PENDING_EXPLANATION` = `technical candidate exists; qualified listening approval pending` (`media-copy.ts`); asserted on `resolveAudioControl` and present in vocabulary detail SSR (`p3d-details-ui.test.ts` ~106, ~203–209).
- **Honest artifact:** generated `learner-details.json` uses `pending-review` / `assetId: null` on representatives; disk test still forbids review plurals, `.mp3`, `media/generated`, etc. (`p3d-details.test.ts` ~128–154).

---

### Regression / boundary scan (P0–P2)

| Area | Result |
|------|--------|
| **Publication / review leakage** | No new client paths for `reviewStatus` / manifest fields in artifacts; `FORBIDDEN_DETAIL_*` walkers unchanged in intent (`access.ts` ~412–427, ~635–671). |
| **Fake audio** | Single pronunciation surface (`DetailViews` → `PronunciationControl`); no other Play/audio wiring in `apps/web`. |
| **React / a11y** | P3D patterns preserved: one `<main>` in shell UI tests, `lang="de"`, disabled pronunciation/recorder with `tabIndex={-1}`; no enabled fake Play. |
| **Prior gates** | P3C still asserts 23 activities + non-representative detail 404 (`p3c-search.test.ts` ~392–405); smoke still covers detail 200 / raw-colon redirect / future 404s (`smoke-canonical-routes.mjs` ~176–216). |
| **Assert weakening** | Runtime validation is **stricter** (contract pins + deep equality), not looser. |

**Non-actionable residuals (P3+ / optional hardening, not P0–P2):**

- Runtime assert does not pin every ancillary learner-visible field (e.g. `personLabel`, `conversationLevels`); P3D P2 scope was core German + structural integrity; practice UI reads pinned `answers[].realization` / verb `form`s.
- `assertMedia` still allows an `approved` + `assetId` **shape** if projection ever emits it; UI remains disabled with honest copy until playback exists (per packet).
- No dedicated adversarial test for extra/missing `byId` key only (logic is present in `access.ts` ~602–608).

---

### Verdict

**APPROVE** — No actionable **P0–P2** findings for P3DR1. Both remediation tracks (canonical runtime/detail integrity with generation assert, array↔`byId` equality, adversarial rejection without value leakage; and disabled pronunciation for pending/approved/missing with exact pending-review copy) are implemented and covered by the touched code and tests as specified.
